# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b27 - Canonical room targets and active controllers

Beta27 is the fresh immutable publication of the fully validated build and supersedes the earlier beta26 tag.

Beta27 is a clean `environment_manager`-only prerelease. There is no historical-domain migration path in the integration.

## Canonical domain only

The release contains one Home Assistant integration domain:

`environment_manager`

Beta27 removes the domain-migration module, migration config-flow step, old-domain runtime constants, legacy storage import and migration UI strings. New state is stored only under canonical `environment_manager.*` storage keys.

## Room Environment owns every operating target

Each configured Room Environment device exposes profile targets according to the capabilities of the physical equipment selected for that room.

Profiles:

- Comfort
- Home
- Away
- Sleep
- Eco

Applicable controls are exposed per profile:

- Heating target °C
- Cooling target °C
- Humidity target %

A heat-only room does not get a fictional cooling target. A humidity-capable room gets humidity targets. Targets remain visible/editable when automation is currently OFF because they are room policy, not an actuator permission.

Away now has explicit user-editable room targets. It no longer silently substitutes the room hard min/max temperature limits.

## Selecting PID / Automatic actually activates the controller

Choosing **Automatic**, **PID** or **Manual** on a managed native controller is the explicit authorization for that exact controller. There is no hidden or second power/HVAC-mode switch.

For supported native climate, fan and humidifier controllers, the selected method can:

- choose the supported operating direction/mode from verified demand;
- turn the physical device or native HVAC mode ON when demand requires it;
- regulate native temperature/humidity/fan targets;
- turn the controller-owned device OFF when demand ends.

**Off** remains the explicit no-control/off method.

The controller still refuses unsafe commands when evidence or hardware state is unsuitable.

## Activation fixes

Beta27 fixes two cases that could leave selected PID/Automatic controllers apparently stuck OFF:

1. Selecting a control method previously recorded the device as having gone OFF at the moment the selector was changed. That could impose a fresh minimum-OFF delay even when the physical unit had already been OFF long enough. Beta27 uses the physical entity's actual observed OFF age.
2. A previous software/manual-override pause could remain latched after the user deliberately selected the method again. Explicitly selecting Automatic/PID/Manual now re-arms that controller.

Real minimum ON/OFF times are still enforced after actual physical transitions.

## Safety remains enforced

Method selection does not bypass:

- physical entity availability;
- exact room/source ownership;
- selected room sensor validity;
- open/unknown window interlocks;
- minimum ON/OFF times;
- maximum Manager-owned runtime;
- defrost protection;
- conflicting HVAC/humidity equipment;
- physical command acknowledgement;
- device identity/source changes;
- manual-running equipment ownership rules.

## Validation

Publication is gated on Python 3.13 and 3.14 regression suites, generated translations, frontend tests, Hassfest, HACS validation, Home Assistant 2026.10 room/setup checks, flat-tag extraction simulation and Hassfest against the exact flattened release payload.

Regression coverage explicitly verifies:

- all five room profiles expose applicable heat/cool/humidity targets;
- profile humidity edits are stored on the Room Environment device and used by runtime target calculation;
- selecting Automatic or PID **without an additional requested HVAC mode** starts an already-dwell-safe native climate device when verified temperature demand requires heating;
- prior software pause is cleared by deliberate method selection;
- real physical OFF duration is used instead of selector-click time;
- no migration module or legacy-domain runtime hook ships.

This is an opt-in beta. Stable Latest remains v0.5.1. Physical HVAC commissioning and manufacturer protections remain authoritative.
